description: we-compare compare entries ("spec-name file") that expect "differs" without naming expectPaths: any difference passes them, also a World Editor step that never applied. "entries": on a JSON kind (written before parseSpec refused that, 2026-11-17): give an entry its expectPaths from a real World Editor run, then take it out. "textEntries": on text, text-set, text-exact, bytes or wpm, which can't name paths (refused since 2026-11-17): compare the file as a JSON kind with expectPaths, or narrow it with lines to what must match, then take it out. Both only shrink (we-compare-runner.test.mjs fails on an entry that is no longer needed, and on a longer list). Emptied 2026-11-17 (branch fix-we-stable): the last six (boundary-flags-wpm, drag-stroke-quick, drag-stroke-raise, low-ground-d-open, water-floor-e-deep-3, water-floor-e-shallow-3), whose differences change from run to run or cover the whole map, name them with expectCorners (w3e: boxes of corners, fields, values and a count per rule).
